notes.title: [March 26 2023 Patch Notes]
notes.content:
[March 26 2023 Patch Notes]

[list]
[*] Tooltips are now available.
[*] You don't need to use the charged tower skill to select.
[*] The HP bar color has been changed to green from gray
[*] 4K setting is not available from the main screen.
[/list]

Thank you!
